platform_identity.name: CrisPRO
platform_identity.tagline: AI that decodes why oncology trials fail — before they cost $300M
platform_identity.thesis: Pharma trials fail not because the target is wrong, but because the wrong patients are enrolled. CrisPRO identifies the patient population and biological conditions under which a trial will succeed or fail — before enrollment begins.
platform_identity.the_one_defensible_claim: CrisPRO would have changed the enrollment decision. Not that it guarantees trial success.
what_crispro_is: An AI-driven oncology trial intelligence platform
A two-layer drug failure prediction system (Layer 1: target biology; Layer 2: patient selection)
A synthetic lethality asset generator (BRIEF programs)
A trial failure corpus decoder (42 trials, 7 programs, 8D framework)
A patient selection algorithm provider for ISTs and pharma BD
what_crispro_is_not: CrisPRO never runs a clinical trial
CrisPRO does not predict individual patient outcomes
CrisPRO does not access proprietary pharma data
CrisPRO does not guarantee trial success
revenue_model: IP licensing — BRIEF SL assets licensed to pharma (benchmark: Roche paid $125M upfront for Repare's camonsertib)
IST support — biomarker strategy, patient selection algorithm, data analysis for investigator-sponsored trials
Validation packages — trial failure decode, patient selection package, BD intelligence package

awards: 2nd place UC Berkeley AgentX Entrepreneurship Track

layer_1.name: Target Biology (Target-Lock Score)
layer_1.question: Is this gene a real driver of the cancer step being targeted?
layer_1.method: Multi-modal: Evo2-7B evolutionary likelihood + Enformer chromatin accessibility + AlphaFold 3 structural confidence
layer_1.panel: 38 genes in real_target_lock_data.csv (AUROC 0.976 self-labeled; AUPRC 0.790 hold-out)

layer_2.name: Patient Selection (Mechanism Fit)
layer_2.question: Are the right patients enrolled? Are their genomic profiles matched to the trial's mechanism?

failure_framework.name: 8D Failure Vector Framework

domains.D1: Biology — target not a genuine driver in enrolled cancer type
domains.D2: Selection — patient population too broad; responder subgroup diluted
domains.D3: Architecture — trial design cannot detect the signal
domains.D4: Timing — drug at wrong disease stage
domains.D5: Combination — partner is antagonistic or redundant
domains.D6: Resistance — pre-existing or acquired resistance bypasses pathway
domains.D8: Systemic — safety signal or regulatory hold

failure_framework.key_insight: Most expensive failures are D2 (Selection) — the target is real, but the enrolled population cannot respond. The responder subgroup exists inside every failed trial. CrisPRO finds the gate.

capability_registry._instructions_for_agent: Each capability has an evidence_tier. SOURCED = cite the source. COMPUTED = receipted run exists. EXPECTED = framework exists but run not executed — label as 'prospective' not 'proven'. ABSENT = no code exists. Never present EXPECTED as COMPUTED.

capabilities.name: Trial Failure Decode (8D Framework)
capabilities.description: Classify any completed or ongoing oncology trial across 8 failure domains. Identify the primary failure mode, the responder subpopulation that existed within the failure, and the biomarker gate that was missing.
capabilities.output_description: 8D failure vector with domain weights, primary/secondary classification, responder subpopulation identification, transfer lesson set
validated_on: CARMEN-LC03 (CEACAM5 ADC, Phase III) — D2 Selection: IHC ≥50% too low
Berzosertib (ATRi) — D2 Selection: RS-High gate missing; ORR 40% vs 5%
Adavosertib (WEE1i) — D2 Selection: PTEN-loss resistance; ORR 0% vs 23%
CAPRI (ATRi+PARPi) — D2 Selection: PARPi-naive gate missing; ORR 36% vs 4%
QUILT-2.004 (vaccine+IO+chemo) — D1 Biology (0.7): pharmacodynamic dissociation
IMblaze370 (MEKi+CPI) — D1 Biology (0.9): MEK inhibition insufficient
CO.26 (D+T) — D2 Selection (0.8): pTMB ≥28 and liver-met status missing
GVAX (vaccine) — D1 Biology (0.8): T-cell activation ≠ tumor regression in MSS CRC
capabilities.cannot_do: Cannot access proprietary trial data. Cannot decode a trial with no published results. Cannot guarantee the decode predicts future trial outcomes.

capabilities.name: Mechanism Fit Scoring (PATH A Engine)
capabilities.description: Score any drug-patient combination using the 8-axis PATH A formula. Produces a fit score [0,1] with axis-level breakdown showing which biological axes drive alignment or misalignment.

from_abstract: drug mechanism (maps to trial vector axes)

capabilities.output_description: fit score [0,1], fit label (LOW/MODERATE/MODERATE-HIGH/HIGH), axis breakdown (which axes drive the score), primary driver axis
validated_on: BreAK CRC-001 (STC-1010): fit=0.7375, io axis PRIMARY DRIVER 46.7%, mapk SECONDARY 30.7%
LATIFY (ceralasertib+durvalumab): responder score 0.8936 vs non-responder 0.6295 — ONLY receipted two-layer demonstration
CARMEN-LC03 (tusamitamab ravtansine): retrospective decode applied
capabilities.cannot_do: PATH B formula is PROHIBITED. LATIFY delta value is QUARANTINED — do not cite a specific delta. Cannot score without knowing the drug's mechanism of action.
capabilities.source: repo_census.md REPO 1.1; crispro_master_pipeline.json platform.scoring_engine; brenus_capability_ownership_matrix.md CAP-01

capabilities.name: Patient Selection Package (Two-Gate System)
capabilities.description: Build a two-gate patient selection framework for any oncology program. Gate 1: target expression threshold (IHC, genomic, liquid biopsy). Gate 2: IO permissiveness or pathway context. Output: ENRICH/CONSIDER/EXCLUDE stratification table.
capabilities.output_description: Two-gate framework, ENRICH/CONSIDER/EXCLUDE table with biomarker thresholds, population size estimate, liquid biopsy proxy identification, protocol enrollment language
validated_on: CEACAM5 (SAR445953): Gate 1 = IHC ≥80% (28% of MSS mCRC); Gate 2 = IO permissiveness (pTMB ≥28 or Immunoscore-IC high). Vector-Scalpel ranking: cCEA (27/33) > pTMB (23/33) > IHC (20/33) > Immunoscore (19/33) > DetermaIO (15/33)
ATR/DDR: Gate 1 = RS-High (berzosertib ORR 40% vs 5%); Gate 2 = PARPi-naive status (CAPRI ORR 36% vs 4%)
MSS CRC IO: Gate 1 = non-liver-metastatic (CO.26 Pint=0.02); Gate 2 = pTMB ≥28 (OS HR=0.34)
capabilities.cannot_do: CEACAM5 IHC ≥80% prevalence in CRC (~28%) is an OPEN_ASSUMPTION (OA-08) — not confirmed from CRC-specific data. cCEA ≥100 data is from NSCLC only — CRC application is by inference.

capabilities.name: Target-Lock Scoring (Layer 1)
capabilities.description: Score any gene against the 8-step metastasis cascade to determine whether it is a genuine metastasis driver. Multi-modal composite: Evo2-7B + Enformer + AlphaFold 3. Panel of 38 genes scored.
capabilities.output_description: target_lock_score [0,1]; HIGH if ≥0.35; per-gene classification across 8 metastasis steps
validated_on: 38-gene panel in real_target_lock_data.csv — AUROC 0.976 ± 0.035 (self-labeled); hold-out AUPRC 0.790
9 FDA-approved genes validated retroactively in predictions_2024_retroactive.json
AUROC 0.689 confirmed in MSK-MET (N=25,775)
capabilities.cannot_do: CEACAM5 is NOT in the 38-gene panel — a CEACAM5 Target-Lock run has not been executed. Any claim that CEACAM5 scores HIGH is EXPECTED (analyst inference), not COMPUTED. Must be labeled as prospective.
capabilities.source: crispro_ceacam5_capability_map_v1.md CAP-05; brenus_capability_ownership_matrix.md CAP-01; crispro_master_pipeline.json platform.validated_predictions

capabilities.name: SL Therapy Bridge (Synthetic Lethality → Drug Mapping)
capabilities.description: Map any SL vulnerability (broken pathway, SL gene pair) to actionable drugs with policy overlay (ALLOW/WARN/DISALLOW). Identifies which drugs are SL-indicated vs. mechanism-aligned vs. false-positive traps.
capabilities.output_description: SLIndicatedDrug list with ActionabilityTier (ALLOW/WARN/DISALLOW/PRECLINICAL_ONLY), PolicyOverlay, GapSummary (top_fit_blocked_count, best_actionable_rank)
validated_on: BRCA2-mut → olaparib/niraparib/rucaparib (ALLOW, VALIDATED)
KRAS-mut NSCLC → EGFR TKIs (DISALLOW — KRAS-mut excludes EGFR TKI benefit)
PTEN-null → mTOR/PI3K inhibitors (WARN)
ATM-mut → ATR inhibitors (ALLOW)
ARID1A-mut → EZH2 inhibitors (ALLOW)
SMARCA4-mut → FHD-909 (ALLOW, PRECLINICAL_ONLY)
CCNE1-amp → CDK2 inhibitors (ALLOW)
capabilities.cannot_do: TP53 and other genes not in SL_THERAPY_MAP return no sl_indicated_drugs (no crash, no hallucination). PTEN-null → ITGAV (BRIEF-2) is COMPUTATIONAL_HYPOTHESIS — DepMap NULL across all 3 proxies — not in SL_THERAPY_MAP.

capabilities.name: BRIEF Program Asset Generation
capabilities.description: CrisPRO has generated 4 synthetic lethality patent assets (BRIEF programs) from CRISPR functional genomics. These are licensable IP assets, not just hypotheses.

input_schema.trigger: Abstract mentions ZEB1, SPP1, NRF2, ITGAV, PTEN-null, or synthetic lethality in NSCLC/BrM/ovarian context

brief_programs.mandatory_disclosure: DepMap NULL across all 3 proxies — not CRISPR-validated. Must disclose in every context where BRIEF-2 appears.

capabilities.cannot_do: BRIEF programs are NSCLC/BrM assets — do not apply to CRC, ovarian, or other indications without a new run. BRIEF-2 is not validated.

capabilities.name: EscapeMap — Bevacizumab Biomarker Stratification (Ovarian)
capabilities.description: ZEB1 expression is a prognostic marker in the bevacizumab arm of ovarian cancer trials. CrisPRO has computed Cox regression, median-split, and tertile analyses across 3 datasets.

key_results.OV_ZEB1_median_split: HR=2.500 (95% CI [1.322, 4.727], log-rank p=0.0036, FDR=0.0499) — bevacizumab arm OS

capabilities.mandatory_wording: Preparatory M2-bevacizumab biomarker panel for downstream descriptive and conditioning analyses — not a validated prognostic signature until dbGaP-linked patient-level outcomes are available. (LOCKED 2026-05-12)

from_abstract: targets mentioning ZEB1, HIF1A, EMT, bevacizumab, VEGF
input_schema.trigger: Abstract mentions ovarian cancer + bevacizumab OR ZEB1/EMT in ovarian context

capabilities.cannot_do: GBM ZEB1 is PERMANENTLY CLOSED — do not apply EscapeMap to GBM. ZEB1 arm interaction p=0.246 means this is prognostic, not bevacizumab-predictive.

CEACAM5 IHC ≥80% OS HR=0.71 (post-hoc, underpowered, CI not published) — candidate predictive gate
CEACAM5 50–79% PFS HR=1.38 (numerically harmful)

IHC ↔ cCEA Spearman ρ=0.43 (n=92)

programs.program_name: MSS CRC Immunotherapy Core Failure Corpus
what_crispro_proved: THREE CONDITIONS for IO benefit in MSS CRC: (1) non-liver-metastatic disease, (2) pTMB ≥28, (3) immune-inflamed TME
CO.26: OS HR=0.73 (marginal); pTMB ≥28 OS HR=0.34 (90% CI 0.18–0.63, p=0.022) — strongest IO signal from randomized data
CO.26: liver-met PFS HR=1.39 vs no-LM PFS HR=0.54; Pint=0.02
REGONIVO US: ORR 7% (5/70); 0/5 liver-met responders; non-liver-met ORR 22% (5/23)
GVAX: ORR 0% despite confirmed T-cell responses — pharmacodynamic dissociation
IMblaze370 (Phase III): OS no significant difference — MEK inhibition definitively fails
AtezoTRIBE: pMMR PFS HR=0.86 (NOT significant); Immunoscore-IC high HR ~0.50 (exploratory)
QUILT-2.004: HR 1.061 (p=0.91) — vaccine + IO + mFOLFOX6 + bev terminated for futility
programs.what_crispro_can_offer: For any MSS CRC IO abstract: identify which of the 3 conditions for IO benefit is present or missing. For trial designs: flag liver metastasis stratification (GAP-01 CRITICAL) and pTMB collection (GAP-02 HIGH) as mandatory. For failed trials: apply 8D decode to identify the primary failure domain.
programs.active_engagement: Brenus Pharma (BreAK CRC-001, STC-1010) — fit score 0.7375
caveats: pTMB ≥28 threshold is data-driven (not pre-specified in CO.26), GuardantOMNI-specific, 2L+ population — requires prospective validation
Liver metastasis is prognostic but AtezoTRIBE 2025 shows it is not predictive of IO resistance when Immunoscore-IC is high (Pint PFS=0.166)

governance_guardrails._admissibility: internal_only — agent uses but does not surface in user-facing output
governance_guardrails._instructions_for_agent: Check every crispro_opportunity output against these guardrails before finalizing. If a prohibited claim is present, remove it. If a mandatory caveat is required, append it.

prohibited_claims.prohibited: Any reference to PATH B formula (cosine similarity with ‖p‖₂ in denominator)
prohibited_claims.reason: PATH B is PROHIBITED — signed decision 2026-04-28

prohibited_claims.prohibited: Any specific LATIFY delta value (e.g., +0.366 or +0.2641)
prohibited_claims.reason: LATIFY delta is QUARANTINED — CT-03 blocker: patent delta +0.366 vs receipt delta +0.2641 — version conflict unresolved
prohibited_claims.correct_statement: LATIFY is the only receipted two-layer demonstration. Responder score 0.8936 vs non-responder 0.6295. Delta value is quarantined.
Do not cite any DDR axis mean value from Figure 2

prohibited_claims.prohibited: Any claim that GBM ZEB1 is a confirmed escape marker
prohibited_claims.reason: GBM ZEB1 PERMANENTLY CLOSED — 3 datasets all null/contradicted (GLASS: delta=−0.34 DOWN; GSE222515: delta=−0.431 DOWN; GSE174554 snRNA-seq: delta=−0.076, p=0.742 NULL)
prohibited_claims.correct_statement: GBM ZEB1 analysis is permanently closed. Do not reopen without new evidence.

prohibited_claims.prohibited: Presenting BRIEF-2 (PTEN-null→ITGAV) as validated or CRISPR-confirmed
prohibited_claims.reason: BRIEF-2 is COMPUTATIONAL_HYPOTHESIS — DepMap NULL across all 3 proxies
prohibited_claims.mandatory_disclosure: PTEN-null→ITGAV is a computational hypothesis. DepMap shows NULL essentiality across all 3 proxies. Not CRISPR-validated. Requires experimental validation before any licensing discussion.

prohibited_claims.prohibited: Claiming CEACAM5 has a confirmed Target-Lock score
prohibited_claims.reason: CEACAM5 is NOT in the 38-gene Target-Lock panel — run has not been executed
prohibited_claims.correct_statement: CEACAM5 Target-Lock scoring is prospective — the framework supports this run but it has not been executed. Label as EXPECTED, not COMPUTED.

prohibited_claims.reason: The only defensible claim is: CrisPRO would have changed the enrollment decision
prohibited_claims.correct_statement: CrisPRO identifies the patient population and biological conditions under which a trial will succeed or fail. It does not guarantee trial success.

prohibited_claims.prohibited: Citing PC-02 retroactive prediction run results
prohibited_claims.reason: PC-02 PERMANENTLY DOWNGRADED — retroactive_prediction_run.py has not cleanly reproduced documented deltas

mandatory_caveats.trigger: Any use of pTMB ≥28 as a predictive biomarker
mandatory_caveats.required_caveat: pTMB ≥28 threshold is data-driven (not pre-specified in CO.26 protocol), GuardantOMNI-specific, derived from 2L+ refractory population, and has not been validated in a prospective Phase III trial. Pint=0.070 (borderline). Requires prospective validation before use as an enrollment criterion.

mandatory_caveats.trigger: Any use of CEACAM5 IHC ≥80% OS HR=0.71
mandatory_caveats.required_caveat: CEACAM5 ≥80% OS HR=0.71 is post-hoc, underpowered, and CI not published. Label as directional trend, not established predictive biomarker.

mandatory_caveats.trigger: Any use of cCEA ≥100 data in CRC context
mandatory_caveats.required_caveat: cCEA ≥100 ORR data (41.7% vs 8.1%) is from NSCLC (NCT02187848). Application to CRC is by inference only. Must be labeled on every slide.

mandatory_caveats.trigger: Any abstract mentioning HT29 or BRAF V600E in vaccine context
mandatory_caveats.required_caveat: SC-001 ACTIVE CONFLICT: HT29 carries BRAF V600E (ATCC/CCLE/COSMIC). BreAK CRC-001 requires BRAF wild-type patients (Exclusion Criterion #7). This scientific inconsistency must be flagged for any vaccine program using HT29 as a cell line component.

mandatory_caveats.trigger: Any use of M2 stratum OS data
mandatory_caveats.required_caveat: Preparatory M2-bevacizumab biomarker panel for downstream descriptive and conditioning analyses — not a validated prognostic signature until dbGaP-linked patient-level outcomes are available. (LOCKED 2026-05-12)

mandatory_caveats.trigger: Any use of LATIFY as a proof-of-concept
mandatory_caveats.required_caveat: LATIFY is the only receipted two-layer demonstration. The specific delta value is quarantined (CT-03 — version conflict unresolved). Do not cite a specific delta. The responder/non-responder score separation (0.8936 vs 0.6295) is the correct citation.

mandatory_caveats.trigger: Any use of BRIEF-3 (ZEB1+PD-1) as evidence of combination benefit
mandatory_caveats.required_caveat: BRIEF-3 correlation r=0.050, p=0.780 (GSE271259, n=34) is statistically insignificant. BRIEF-3 is MECHANISTICALLY_GROUNDED, not CRISPR_VALIDATED. The combination hypothesis is supported by mechanistic literature but not by the GSE271259 correlation.

mandatory_caveats.trigger: Any use of OV ZEB1 arm interaction as bevacizumab-predictive
mandatory_caveats.required_caveat: OV ZEB1 arm interaction HR=1.243, p=0.246 — PROGNOSTIC, NOT ARM-SPECIFIC. ZEB1 is a prognostic marker in the bevacizumab arm, not a predictive marker of bevacizumab benefit.

evidence_tier_enforcement.SOURCED: Cite the source. No arithmetic. No cross-study transfer.
evidence_tier_enforcement.COMPUTED: Receipted run exists. Cite the receipt. State the specific output values.
evidence_tier_enforcement.EXPECTED: Framework exists but run not executed. Label as 'prospective' or 'the next execution step'. Never present as COMPUTED.
evidence_tier_enforcement.ABSENT: No code exists. Do not claim this capability exists. State it as a gap.

sc_001_flag.description: HT29 carries BRAF V600E (established cell line biology — ATCC HTB-38, CCLE, COSMIC). BreAK CRC-001 Exclusion Criterion #7 requires BRAF wild-type patients. Any vaccine program using HT29 as a cell line component and enrolling BRAF WT patients has a scientific inconsistency.
sc_001_flag.trigger: Abstract mentions HT29 OR BRAF V600E in vaccine/cell line context
sc_001_flag.action: Flag the conflict. Do not suppress it.
